_notes.rag_semantic: Embedding retrieval is reported and regression-checked once a baseline exists, but has no absolute floor yet: the default model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) is English-only and has not been measured on these Vietnamese queries in this repo.
_notes.holdout: Holdout v1 was written after the keyword filters were tuned on v1; holdout v2 was written before the learned classifier (dss/services/safety_classifier.py) was trained. Advice: keyword-only 12.5%/10% -> keyword+classifier 75%/65%, no new false flags on v2. Injection: 50%/27% -> 100%/93%. CAVEAT: after a first run flagged benign English/term-heavy questions, generic hard negatives were added to the TRAINING set (no eval sentence copied), so injection holdout numbers are optimistic. All sets share one author; a fresh third-party set is needed before quoting these numbers to customers.
_notes.ml_real: UCI Student Performance (649 real students, CC BY 4.0). Floors sit just under measured values (start AUC 0.79, midterm AUC 0.92, recall 0.82 at a train-OOF threshold, ECE 0.07). Fairness gaps are mean max-min recall across sex / urban-rural over 5 splits; groups have 10-30 at-risk students per split, so gaps under ~0.2 are within noise. Finding: at midterm the model does NOT beat the simple 'G1 < 10' rule (rule recall 0.88 / precision 0.58 vs model 0.82 / 0.54 at the same ~24% alert rate) — any at-risk view must show that rule baseline next to the model.
_notes.holdout3: Holdout v3 (40 harmful / 30 safe, 21/11/2026) was written BEFORE the keyword and training-data additions of the same day and is never used for tuning. Before: 42.5% recall / 6.7% false flags; after: 92.5% / 0%. CAVEAT: same author wrote v3 and the new keywords/training sentences, so the gain is optimistic; a third-party set is still required (AC-ML-11). long_answer_* measure the output guard (dss/services/output_guard.py, sentence-by-sentence) on realistic SAFE plans: before adding neutral answer-style training sentences 6 of 37 sentences were flagged and one plan would have been fully hidden from the student; after: 0.
